items.title: Castrol’s Growth Playbook: Rural Push, Synthetic Upgrade, and EV Readiness
items.summary: Castrol India is entering its next phase of growth at a time when the lubricant market is becoming more complex. items.title: India’s critical minerals sector faces financing constraints despite policy push: Report
items.summary: Volatile demand and supply conditions, sharp fluctuations in critical mineral prices, long gestation periods and high upfront capital requirements are restricting capital flow into the sector.
